purpose: Teach: 配線/一周/進め方/納入/現職/心構え/立ち上がる/取り組ま

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の配線、すべて手作業だった。
lines.en: The old wiring work—it was all done by hand.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective voice. A long breath before the dash, like settling into memory. Patient pace, as if watching the work happen again in his mind.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員、社屋を一周する朝礼、続けています。
lines.en: Yes. We've kept up the tradition—staff walks the whole building every morning.
lines.style: Respectful, measured delivery. A small pause before the specific detail, like placing each piece of the habit carefully. Steady and grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 進め方、若い頃に習った、根気が要る。
lines.en: The way it's done—I learned it when I was young. It demands patience.
lines.style: Teaching tone without lecturing. Light emphasis on 'patience,' like the word itself carries weight. Slow enough to let it land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。先輩から、納入の流儀、引き継いでいます。
lines.en: Yes. I inherited how we deliver—the company's way—from my predecessor.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Slight lift on 'inherited,' honoring the lineage. Deliberate pacing, each clause distinct.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 現職員、伝統を、伝えていけ。
lines.en: Your staff now—they need to pass this tradition along.
lines.style: Direct and unadorned. A touch of authority, but gentle. Like a compass being handed over. Slight pause between phrases.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。新人に心構え、丁寧に伝えます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll teach the new hires the mindset carefully, with care.
lines.style: Earnest and deliberate. Emphasis on care—not rushed, not perfunctory. Slight weight on 'carefully,' showing he takes the responsibility seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 事業を立ち上がる勢い、若い頃と同じく、持ち続けろ。
lines.en: The momentum of starting something—keep that drive as you had it when you were young.
lines.style: Final instruction, firm but not harsh. A slight warmth underneath—faith in him. Ends with quiet conviction, like a benediction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。挑戦に取り組ませる組織、目指します。
lines.en: Yes. I'm building an organization where people embrace challenge and grow through it.
lines.style: Clear, forward-looking close. Confident without arrogance. The 'yes' lands like a vow. Ends with quiet resolve, looking ahead.
